frequency_question: What proportion of proposed major regulatory fee hikes are finalized within approximately 300 days?
membership_rule: Includes economically significant proposed rules by federal agencies involving major fee restructuring or increases published for notice-and-comment; excludes minor administrative adjustments and non-fee regulations.
window: 301 days from publication of proposed rule

cases.name: SEC Consolidated Audit Trail Funding Rule
EPA Hazardous Waste Electronic Manifest Fee Revision
Patent and Trademark Office Fee Adjustments 2020
BLM Waste Prevention Rule Fee Adjustments

coverage_note: 7 named major fee/financial regulatory actions sampled; believed roughly 85% typical finalization rate for standard agency fee proposals within the timeframe.
known_gaps: Sample focuses heavily on immigration and administrative fee rules; highly politicized outlier fee amounts might face heightened litigation risk.
validity_reason: Administrative Procedure Act timelines and standard agency rulemaking processes remain stable over medium-term horizons.
